# Everything `mkdocs serve` / `mkdocs build` needs, and nothing else: the
# API pages are generated by static analysis of src/ (griffe), so torch and
# pystreme itself need not be installed in the docs environment.
#     pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
mkdocs>=1.6,<2
mkdocs-material>=9.5,<10
mkdocstrings[python]>=0.26
# On Python 3.10 pip can only get mkdocstrings 1.0.6, which breaks on
# pymdown-extensions 12 ("Highlight.__init__() missing ... 'md'"); 11.x works.
# Newer Pythons get releases that work together, so they are left alone.
pymdown-extensions<12; python_version < "3.11"
